name: 2dai-mcp-server
description: MCP server for 2DAI — let Claude, Cursor, Cline and Windsurf generate images and video, upload references and organise your cloud drive on your own 2DAI account.

scripts.lint:stdout: ! grep -rnE 'console\.(log|info|debug|dir|table)\(' src/ || (echo 'stdout write in src/ corrupts the stdio JSON-RPC stream' && exit 1)
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint:stdout && npm run build
scripts.docker:build:push:amd64:live: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --progress plain --tag zelstudioshared/2dai-dappv2-mcp-live:latest-amd64 . && docker push zelstudioshared/2dai-dappv2-mcp-live:latest-amd64
scripts.docker:build:push:arm64:live: docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64 --progress plain --tag zelstudioshared/2dai-dappv2-mcp-live:latest-arm64 . && docker push zelstudioshared/2dai-dappv2-mcp-live:latest-arm64
